shortDescription: Moca Network (MOCA) is scheduled to unlock about 167.65 million tokens at 12:00 AM on September 11 (UTC+8), according to Web3 asset data platform RootData's token unlock data. According to ChainCatcher, the tokens are valued at about $1.49 million.
